$comment: English texts of data/orbs.json (src/engine/orbs.js, src/server/orbs.js): the words of the System Orbs over the exploration's scene, and of the Profession Orbs over a work's scene (`professions`).

texts.label: Catch the System Orb
texts.noExploration: System Orbs only appear during an exploration.
texts.noOrb: There is no such System Orb.
texts.early: This System Orb has not arrived yet.
texts.gone: This System Orb has already faded.
texts.claimed: This System Orb has already been caught.
texts.limit: That's all the System Orbs for today ({count}). More after midnight.

texts.label: Catch the Profession Orb
texts.productLost: Profession Orb: +{amount} × {product}. The bag is full, no room for: {lost}.
texts.noWork: Profession Orbs only appear while your character works in a profession.
texts.noOrb: There is no such Profession Orb.
texts.early: This Profession Orb has not arrived yet.
texts.gone: This Profession Orb has already faded.
texts.claimed: This Profession Orb has already been caught.
texts.limit: That's all the Profession Orbs for today ({count}). More after midnight.
